__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A ring, with yellow and green ornamentation. It looks very old.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It feels heavy.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: ring yellow green

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A halfway decayed corpse of a cartographer.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
Ew.  This must have been the mapper that was lost in Moria.  His rotted hand
still clutches a partially digested map...

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: corpse

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small pile of coins.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: coins

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A worn and rusty dagger is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It's old and rusted, but it still has a good edge.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: dagger rusty

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A coiled length of leather is here...looks like a nasty whip!
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: bullwhip whip

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: An uprooted tree leans against the wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This is the biggest club you have ever seen!  The giant didn't even bother to
trim the roots off the end.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: club tree huge

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A heap of smelly furs sit here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
They're heavy and smelly and would probably slow you down...but they do look
like good armor.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: furs smelly

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A purple potion is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It looks rather strange!

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: potion purple

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A metal helmet is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: helmet metal

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small mushroom is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: Let's put it this way - I wouldn't eat it !

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: mushroom

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A beautifully crafted dirk is lying here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's a medium sized, beautifully crafted dirk made from grey alloy.
Its blade is double-edged and very thin ... this looks like a good
thieves weapon.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: dirk

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A razor-sharp war axe rests on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It has an edge sharp enough to cut a passing thought. A good find, this.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: axe war

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A well-polished broadsword sits here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It's much heavier than a long sword, but not as well balanced.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sword broad

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A flail with two heavy, spiked heads is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's a stout wooden rod with two spiked balls attached, each weighing over 2
pounds.  It's a little worn for wear, but looks most painful.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: flail two two-headed

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A large iron mace with a wicked head rests on the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: A metal shaft mounted with an iron head, shaped into armor-shattering form.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: mace heavy

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A curved sword with a heavy tip sits here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's curved like a scimitar, only with no recurved blade and a tip designed
for piercing as well as slashing.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: falchion sword

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A long polearm with a curved blade is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It looks a lot like a staff with a pruning knife tied to the end, but it's
quite effective.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: voulge polearm

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: An evil black demon blade is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You'll become as evil as the weapon, if you use it!

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: blade black demon

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Some gloves are here.  They look like the right equipment for fighting.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: gloves

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A scroll which reads "ysafg", it looks very fragile and quite old.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It looks informative.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scroll ysafg

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A green slime mold is here. It smells REAL bad.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It wasn't meant to be food, - Certainly not for humans.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: slime mold

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A green slime mold is here. It smells REAL bad.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It wasn't meant to be food, - Certainly not for humans.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: slime mold

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A long staff capped with iron leans against a wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It's a superb weapon for warrior or mage.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: staff iron iron-shod

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A thick black potion is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It looks healthy.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: black potion

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A ancient heavy oak staff is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The runes says : Funthark.
You see it has some sort of runes on it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: staff oak

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A light silver dagger is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It looks like an excellent weapon for thieves.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: dagger light silver

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A heavy, spiked morning star is here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
It's a huge length of wood studded with iron spikes and bands. You wouldn't
want to meet this in a dark alley...

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: star morning morningstar
